title: SMIT Ghotki Campus, Ghotki | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: SMIT Ghotki Campus, located in Ghotki, Pakistan. Address: Jeejal Aman Public School. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Ghotki as the city.
